checks.name: Body-only change preserves all joint definitions
Body-only change updates visual collision and inertia

limitations: Parser-level validation does not validate physical dynamics or simulator contact stability.
Masses, bounding-box inertias, collision boxes and limits are preliminary estimates, not measured hardware specifications.
Knee is an equivalent serial revolute, not motor shaft angle; omitted closed-loop linkage is not simulated.
Front pitch motors are reconstructed with pelvis transforms; no independently modeled front motor instances exist in overview CAD.
Joint link rotations are proper rotations. CAD mirror transforms are baked into mesh geometry and may have determinant -1.
cad_warnings: Four-corner overview includes only printed solids; applying identical transforms to motors is a reconstruction, not independently modeled motor instances.
Front leg is mirrored in X about 38.75 mm; front pelvis is not. Rear/front and left/right transforms must be selected by group.
Closed parallelogram uses crank/pushrod linkage. A serial knee revolute is a reduced kinematic approximation; omitted crank and pushrod must not be frozen into thigh/shank visuals.
Foot is fixed only as a simulation choice. CAD attachment permits an axis; material/contact properties cannot be inferred from geometry.
As-modeled pose has horizontal upper thighs and vertical shanks, not a typical standing crouch. Joint-zero conversion must be explicit.
Motor mesh exports contain assembled horns. Keeping each complete servo mesh with its housing means its visual horn is not independently animated.

Foot attachment center is approximately 19.499 mm above lowest tessellated CAD foot surface (0.05 mm tessellation) in as-modeled pose; OCC Shape.BoundBox is looser on curved geometry. Do not place contact sphere at attachment center without measuring actual mesh offset.
